name: singlet_simulation_reference_matched_counts
title: Reference-matched count simulation and fidelity check
description: Fits a reference-matched count simulator to a labelled raw-count dataset and samples a synthetic .singlet of the requested size, with cell-type labels and a fidelity record. The default scdesign2 fits per-cell-type Poisson, negative binomial or zero-inflated marginals with a Gaussian copula; splatter, symsim and scdesign3_nb are comparators. Needs raw counts in layers/counts and writes only to the new output dataset. Its fidelity record measures summary realism and classifier separability, not fitness for a downstream analysis.

dataset.description: Reference dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with raw UMI counts in layers/counts.

output.description: Destination handle for the synthetic .singlet dataset; the input dataset is never modified.

simulator.description: Fitter and sampler; scdesign2 is the proposed default, the others are comparators.

n_cells.description: Synthetic cells; null uses the reference size.

n_genes.description: Genes drawn at random, seeded, among those with nonzero total count; null keeps all.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels; the fit is stratified by it. Null fits one population.

holdout.description: Held-out level excluded from the fit and used as the realism reference.

key.description: obs column naming the held-out unit, such as study or donor.

level.description: Value of key that is held out.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for gene draws, fitting and sampling; required for reproducibility.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members in the output dataset instead of failing.

scdesign2.description: Options for the scdesign2 fitter; rejected unless simulator is scdesign2.

marginal.description: Per-gene marginal family; auto_choose selects by likelihood-ratio tests.

pval_cutoff.description: Significance level for choosing zero inflation over the non-inflated family.

epsilon.description: Clamp keeping randomised quantiles away from 0 and 1.

jitter.description: Randomise discrete counts before the probability integral transform.

splatter.description: Options for the splatter comparator; rejected unless simulator is splatter.

estimate.description: Estimate means, library sizes and BCV from the reference; false uses package defaults, which are not reference-matched.

dataset.description: Handle of the reference dataset that was read; never modified.

synthetic_dataset.description: Handle of the synthetic dataset; null for dry_run and queued.

status.description: completed: fitted and sampled inline; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written to the synthetic dataset. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: simulator, n_cells, n_genes, copula_genes, ks_statistics (T values), null_position per statistic and c2st_accuracy per classifier (both only when holdout is set).

provenance_id.description: Provenance record appended to the synthetic dataset; null unless completed.

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
